summary.what_it_is: Sure is a community-maintained fork of the abandoned Maybe Finance personal finance app. It can be self-hosted with Docker and accessed via web browser, macOS desktop app, mobile app, API clients, and LLM agents.
summary.why_trending: No clear reason in the project's own text.
summary.who_its_for: People who want a self-hosted personal finance app and developers interested in contributing to a community-driven finance platform.
